name: Loungefly Disney Lilo & Stitch Fruits Wallet - BoxLunch Exclusive
description: This Loungefly wallet can't get any sweeter! The beloved alien from Disney's Lilo & Stitch is printed all over the exterior along with watermelon slices, pineapples, Dole Whip cones, flowers, and pastel stripes. Features a magnetic button closure, a brand plaque, and an exterior pocket. Inside, you'll find 2 interior sections, a zipper pocket, an ID slot, a cash slot, and 6 card slots. A BoxLunch Exclusive!
